name: Healthy RC Youth Leaders
what_you_do: Speak up for teens in your city. You work with city staff on mental health, healthy living and the environment, learn how city government works and go to trainings.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 12 to 17 in middle or high school.
duration: One school year (2026 to 2027 is the current group).
deadline_text: Applications for the 2026 to 2027 group closed Sunday, Aug 16, 2026. The next round is not posted yet.
how_to_apply: Use the Youth Leaders Application link on the city page when it opens. Questions: HealthyRC@cityofrc.us.
notes: Youth Leaders can speak for the group at local and national events. The page does not list meeting days or times, so ask Healthy RC.
